newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures lower in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures lower in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were lower in after-hours trade on Tuesday, as private investors were quick to take advantage of any price rally to sell, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.5 yen to 1.6 yen per kg lower than the day's close. Benchmark March was 0.5 yen down at 134.4 yen.
During the day, technical buying and firmer Thai benchmark rubber offer prices to Japan made prices recover from the day's early lows. Volume during the day was 5,091 lots.
"Market players were divided over near-term direction," an analyst at a commodity broker said.
